title: kummer derived unit
statement: On an essentially small site with terminal object and the stated sheafification/exactness hypotheses, let n>0 and H be a ULift(Z/n)-module sheaf. If 0→UH→G→G→0 is short exact, the last map being n, its positive connecting class in Ext^1(G,UH) has the unbounded DerivedExtUnit property [def-sp-derived-scalar-ext-unit].

source.place: Derived reduction, finite coefficient extension and canonical comparison paragraphs

proof.text: In integer modules use the split extension G→G→0 in normalized divisible-extension reduction. Its Kummer identification identifies the derived adjunction unit with the positive connecting class. Realize raw residue-module sheaves as constant-ring modules and abelian sheaves as integer modules. Exact equivalences transport the universal property. Naturality of the short exact Ext class identifies the transported connecting class without changing its sign.

theorem kummer_derived_unit [EssentiallySmall.{u + 1} C] [HasTerminal C]
    (n : ℕ) (hn : 0 < n)
    (G : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    (H : Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n))))
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wAb} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wMod}
      (Sheaf J (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n))))]
    [HasExt.{wE} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})]
    [(sheafCompose J (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n))) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (sheafCompose J
      (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n))) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}))]
    (i : (sheafCompose J (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj H ⟶ G)
    (hi : i ≫ (n • 𝟙 G) = 0)
    (hK : (ShortComplex.mk i (n • 𝟙 G) hi).ShortExact) :
    (sheafCompose J (forget₂ (ModuleCat.{u + 1} (ULift.{u + 1} (ZMod n)))
      AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).DerivedExtUnit G H 1
        (ShortComplex.ShortExact.extClass.{wE} hK)
